network.stated_total_quote: Karlsruhe University of Applied Sciences maintains academic relations with more than 180 universities around the world. Within Europe, these are generally bilateral agreements regarding the academic mobility of students and/or university staff for teaching, further education and training within the framework of the Erasmus+ program. The relevant agreements define the study cycles (bachelor, master, doctorate) and the subject areas to which the mobility program relates in each case.
network.coverage_note: The evidence provides a list of selected cooperation projects and mentions that there are more than 180 partner universities, but a full list of all individual Erasmus partners is not provided in the text.
